questions.text: It is 2026-11-09 and this lost 1R: Brent went through 98.0 first, which random entries with your target and stop did 38.3% of the time. What happened? Name at least one reason that is a thesis error, not luck.

The source of this idea is consensus, yet managed money sits only at the 17.0th percentile on your side: what do you see that the consensus view you took it from does not, and would you still hold it if that consensus changed its mind?
